# Receipt service promise migration

Migrate this ESM project from error-first callbacks to promises across memory-store.js, receipts.js, console.js, and batch.js. The new public service is `buildReceipt(id, store): Promise<{id,customer,totalCents}>` exported by src/receipts.js. REMOVE its obsolete `loadReceipt` export (do not keep a callback shim). `OrderNotFoundError` remains exported with name "OrderNotFoundError", message `order not found: <id>`, and `.id` equal to the missing id.

Store contract: `await store.open()` yields a session; `await session.order(id)` returns `{customerId,lines:[{sku,quantity}]}` or null; `await session.customer(customerId)` returns `{name}` or null; `await session.price(sku)` returns integer cents; `await session.close()` closes it. Call these with ONLY the specified arguments (no callbacks). Build in this order: open, order, customer, then price once per line in input order, then close. A repeated SKU is still read once per line. Empty lines total zero. Missing customer gives customer "Guest"; a found name (even empty) is preserved. Total is sum of price*quantity, including zero quantities. Missing order throws OrderNotFoundError, without customer/price reads. Always await close exactly once if open succeeded, including missing orders or failed reads. No close after open failure. Read/open failures propagate by original object identity; a close failure rejects with its original reason after an otherwise successful operation, but NEVER masks a prior read or missing-order failure (even if that failure reason is undefined/null/false). Do not start reads after a failed read. Assume well-formed order/customer/price data; no new validation required.

`MemoryStore` in src/memory-store.js keeps constructor `{orders,customers,prices}` Maps and an `events` array. Migrate `open`, session `order`, `customer`, `price`, `close` to promise APIs (no callback parameters). `events` records respectively "open", "order:<id>", "customer:<id>", "price:<sku>", "close". Missing order/customer returns null; missing price rejects Error(`unknown sku: <sku>`). Keep each session's own close state; after close, its order/customer/price reject Error("session closed"); close is idempotent and logs once. Multiple sessions are independent. Do not mutate data Maps or order objects.

`printReceipt(id,store)` in console.js remains async and returns `<id> | <customer> | <totalCents>`; `collectReceipts(ids,store)` in batch.js remains async and processes IDs SEQUENTIALLY in input order, returns formatted strings and stops on first error without opening later IDs. Migrate both callers to async/await with buildReceipt; no callback adapters left. Existing visible tests run via `node --test test/*.test.js`.
